reasoning: The only long-dead mortal Character with a surviving related Memory is Fra Anzelmo (Memory IV, unlost). The harness exposes no restore/un-strike operation for a struck Character, and this return doesn't need one: he comes back as an animate, unquiet remnant rather than a living man restored to play, so his Character stays struck. He wants the confession he never got to hear before she broke his neck.

operations.text: Something wearing Fra Anzelmo's ruined shape claws up outside Alexandria's walls, sustained on whatever hatred survives a broken neck, and demands the confession he never got to hear; I recite it back to him in Latin, and he crumbles to nothing at last, satisfied.
